title: Controller Grant
description: That one machine may act for the identity that issued this, as the signer named here, at the grade named here, while this is unrevoked and has not lapsed.

u.description: Salt, when the credential is issued private

i.description: Issuer: the identity that owns the asset

ri.description: The registry the grant is issued in, where its revocation is recorded

u.description: Salt, when the attributes are issued private

i.description: The asset's identifier: the holder of this grant

asset_type.description: The kind of asset this grant is for

name.description: The asset's name when the grant was issued

valid_until.description: When the grant lapses. Absent, it holds until revoked

public_key.description: The machine's key, which its identifier names and its requests are checked against

label.description: Which machine this is, as the person who paired it named it

grade.description: enrolled for a machine the person keeps, scoped for one they borrowed

signer.description: The signer this machine acts as, when the identity has signers

request.description: The request that authorised this, as it was signed: who signed it (a machine acting for a signer, or the identity's own key), the exact string signed, which carries the digest of the request's body, the signature, and what the request asked for, taken from that body. The body itself is not here: it can hold what is nobody else's business, and is kept with the issuer's record

about.description: What the authorising request named as the thing it acts on: the asset whose grant changes, or the machine waiting to become its body

oneOf.description: Edges: the credentials this one rests on, each by its identifier and schema
